subject: why delayed-start accounts cannot recover the champion path; closes the start-stress diagnostic line
causal_chain: 1. The champion edge is one formation grant: a synchronized reversal_industry FULL_COHORT over the optical pair [sz300308, sz300394] with decisive owner sz300308, admitted 2023-01-04 at 0.95 weight. The synchronized full-cohort quorum needs only 2 confirmation days and bypasses the per-name quality gates (full_compatibility path in evaluate_strategic_quorum).

2. The route predicate window is calendar-bound: sz300308/sz300394/sz300502 satisfy reversal_industry only from 2023-01-03 to 2023-01-06. From 2023-01-09 the group leaves the route permanently. Any session starting on or after 2023-01-10 can never observe the window, regardless of streak accounting.

3. Delayed starts therefore form the next available synchronized group instead: the equipment cohort [sh688072, sh688120, sz300223] on 2023-01-19. Both held members exit by 2023-03-24 with confirmed structural deterioration.

4. No secondary concentrated path ever opens for the missed leader: across the whole 2023-01-10 run there are 0 sessions where sz300308 simultaneously satisfies strict_absolute_owner_quality and independent_market_confirmation (376 candidate sessions observed). The two gates are temporally exclusive: once the name matures into absolute quality (from 2023-03-23) the market overheating gate (max(broad_ret120, tech_ret120) <= strategic_long_cycle_max_tech_ret120) is already failing, and vice versa.

5. After the equipment cohort dies the account deploys only ordinary core admissions (0.19-0.27 weights), is flushed by the 2023-05-05 crisis, holds cash 2023-08-11 to 2024-07-22, and never regains concentrated leader exposure. Final wealth 1.898x versus 32.579x for the on-time start.
ceiling_argument: The champion terminal wealth is dominated by the 0.95-weight first-week grant compounded over 3.5 years. Honest delayed-start paths are capped by the session's residual non-grant alpha at ordinary admission weights, roughly 2x-3x. The observed start retention 0.0408-0.0639 is already near that ceiling; the frozen start bounds (median >= 0.85, minimum >= 0.75) are unreachable by any causally clean mechanism.

rejected_alternatives.pre_session_streak_warm_start: Causally clean but ineffective here: the formation window closes before the delayed start, so replayed pre-session observations would reset to zero before the first session anyway.
rejected_alternatives.lookahead_backfill_of_the_grant: Violates the causal validation identity of the project; not considered further.
rejected_alternatives.coexistence_ordinary_admission: Already tested (coexistence-diagnostic.patch, PUBLIC_AND_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT.json diagnostics.coexistence): delayed start improves 1.90x -> 2.60x, still ~0.075 retention, and changes the champion path (29.7x -> 34.7x), breaking bit-for-bit champion agreement. Not a fix.
rejected_alternatives.concentrated_readoption_of_mature_leader: Would require relaxing the market overheating gate for new concentrated entries, i.e. buying concentrated into an overheated market. That is an economic redesign of the risk philosophy, not a bounded recovery fix; recorded as a user decision item, not implemented.
